title: Mongo: backup take (mongodump --archive --gzip)
description: Runs `nexus backup take mongo --tag <t>`: mongodump of the nexus_smoke application DB to a node-local gzip archive on a secondary.

observe.what: backup id (mongo-demo-<ts>) · destination /var/backups/nexus-mongo/<id>.archive.gz (node-local on a secondary) · size > 0
the .archive.gz file exists with the reported size

whatProves: MongoAdapter.BackupTakeAsync produces a non-empty mongodump archive of nexus_smoke (URI database path scopes the dump; reads from PRIMARY).
